name: Playback Info Card
description: Admin playback session monitor displaying active streams, play state, and real-time transcode telemetry.
overview: Admin playback session monitor displaying active streams, play state, and real-time transcode telemetry.

versions.changelog: Release v0.2.5.0 - Truthful transcode diagnostics additions: estimated finish time (ETA), Dolby Atmos/DTS:X detection, audio track language, and subtitle delivery method (surfaces burned-in subtitles as a genuine transcode cause) -- none inferred, all read directly from server-reported fields. Adds the user's own avatar next to their name and a layered cinema-poster shadow on artwork. Fixes a Remux/Transcode misclassification in the personal My Playback API, hardens secret storage (no more guessable fallback key, no silent ACL failures, no silent secret wipe on key mismatch), fixes a notification dedupe race condition, adds Brotli response support to the dashboard injector, and brings the Info-panel persistence fix to the standalone Playback Monitor page.

Release v0.2.4.1 - Singleton Info drawer that survives polling (fixes Info closing itself every 3s), real brand-accurate client logos (Chrome/Safari/Edge/Firefox/Brave and ~20 third-party/device clients replacing single-color placeholders), Remux/DirectPlay no longer show the Transcode-only "Reason not reported by server" text, corrected header method-count chip order (Direct Play/Direct Stream/Remux/Transcode/Paused, Remux always shown), expanded 26-field grouped technical breakdown, extended artwork fallback chain, and removal of a raw session-ID DOM leak in Connected Devices.

Release v0.2.4.0 - Corrective patch: complete in-place replacement of Jellyfin 12.1 Devices widget with strict exclusion of navigation drawer links, zero top-of-page fallback, connected devices preservation, and accessible 22-field technical breakdown drawer with distinct Source/Output resolution and container telemetry.

Release v0.2.3.7 - Telemetry accuracy corrections: Remux and Direct Stream separation in header counts, strict QSV/HW engine suppression when video is direct, truthful framerate parsing (rejection of ffmpeg throughput counter 2191 fps), server-reported transcode reasons without speculative inference, TV series artwork fallback, and accessible 21-field technical breakdown drawer.
Release v0.2.3.6 - In-place replacement of modern Jellyfin 12.1 React/MUI Devices widget, zero top-of-page fallback, connected devices visibility, and No active playback empty state.
